The Hire ✅ Verified

Wells-Stallworth led the board that hired Brian Banks — a man with 9 criminal convictions including 6 felonies — as superintendent of MacDowell Preparatory Academy.

The Free Press (August 2023) asked why:

“Banks’ history of financial misdeeds is well-known to political insiders like Wells Stallworth and her fellow board members. In fact, Wells Stallworth said Banks’ troubled past is one of the reasons MacDowell’s board voted — unanimously — to hire him.”

She told the Free Press:

“It was determined by the board that he is well qualified, as an educator, a scholar, and a community leader.”

Left unanswered by the Free Press:

“whether Wells Stallworth is aware of Banks’ most recent financial problems and what role her family’s relationship with Banks played in the decision to hire him at MacDowell.”

The family’s relationship with Banks was forged at the Black Caucus Foundation of Michigan, where Banks served on the board alongside Keith Stallworth (Managing Director) and Thomas Stallworth III (Director).

The Campaign Donations

“The $1,250 that Wells Stallworth and her husband, Tommy, donated” made “them among Banks’ most generous supporters.”

— Detroit Free Press, Aug 27, 2023

The Cover-Up — 2 Hours, 24 Minutes ✅ Verified

On February 28, 2022, MDE sent a formal investigation letter to Wells-Stallworth regarding Banks operating without credentials. The MDE FOIA response (Sep 25, 2026) documented what happened next:

TimeEventActor
Feb 22, 12:24 PMMDE warns Banks has no credential — “the Academy is out of compliance with law”Leah Breen (MDE)
Feb 28, 8:26 AMInvestigation letter sent to Wells-StallworthKatie Schmiedeknecht (MDE)
Feb 28, ~8:40 AMWells-Stallworth loops in attorney — 14 minutesNicole Wells-Stallworth
Feb 28, 9:13 AMAttorney: “I have not fix for this at this time”Gregory Meihn (Foley & Mansfield)
Feb 28, 10:50 AMMDE: “no need for an investigation”Katie Schmiedeknecht (MDE)
Feb 28, 11:15 AMAttorney: “Thank you. Nicole, please call again”Gregory Meihn

Total elapsed: 2 hours, 24 minutes from investigation letter to clearance.

Wells-Stallworth retained a national law firm (Foley & Mansfield PLLP — offices in 13 cities) within 14 minutes of receiving the letter. An experienced public affairs executive with deep media and political connections deployed those connections to make a state investigation disappear in a single morning.

What Happened After the Investigation Died

DateEvent
Feb 28, 2022MDE investigation killed
Jul 1, 2022MacDowell goes “self-managed” — Banks IS the management
Sep 1, 2022Banks applies for teaching certificate
Sep 2, 2022Certificate issued one day later
2023MacDowell reports 3% math proficiency
2024MacDowell reports continued poor performance
2025-2026Banks still superintendent

They told MDE Banks wasn’t in a credentialed role. Then they made him the sole manager four months later.

The Pattern

Nicole Wells-Stallworth is the connective tissue of this network. She bridges:

  • The Stallworth political dynasty (husband, brother-in-law, mother-in-law) to the Banks enterprise
  • The BCF felon incubator to the MacDowell school board
  • The MDE credential investigation to its 2-hour death
  • The charter authorization pipeline through her stepdaughter on DPSCD
  • The national law firm response (Foley & Mansfield) to a state-level compliance inquiry

She is a C-level nonprofit executive, an experienced political operative, a Planned Parenthood leader, and a governor’s ally. She used all of that institutional knowledge — not to protect students getting 3% math proficiency — but to protect Brian Banks from accountability.
